Data.CultureInvariantString: You nearly froze my hand off, Eli. You fucking owe me.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do you want me to say?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: The fucking thing, Eli. Whatever's in the pod. It's...slithering.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Slithering? What the...what are you talking about?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: ...Okay, alright. That's bad. What do we do?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: What the fuck are you waiting for, Eli? Hurry up!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Here's the cooling spray, take it!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Give me a second! I'll be right back.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Okay, on the count of three, I'm going to twist the pod open a bit more. As soon as it splits, I want you to douse the fucker, alright?
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Okay, I'm going to twist this thing open again, and when I do, I'm going to need you to hold the container still. I'll twist it, drop it, and you shut it. You got that?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You twist it, drop it, and I shut it. Got it.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I don't know. I...need to gather my thoughts.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do you make of that thing?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Anything I can do to help?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I should go make the call. I'll talk to you later.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Are you kidding me, Eli?! Either grab the spray and pacify it, or we risk it and pull it into a container. Just do SOMETHING!
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Alright. Man. What was that...thing? What was that, Eli?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (REALIST) Progress. Just not sure what kind yet.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (IDEALIST) Looks like the fruit of our labour to me.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I don't know. I'm not sure I wanna find out, but I'm sure HQ does.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I don't know...man, can't you make a decision for yourself?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Sorry, Jorge. I'll figure it out myself.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You know more about this than I do. I figured you'd want to call the shots.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'll tell you later! For now, help me get this thing contained!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do we do? What do you need?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm on it! I'll be right back, okay?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: There! Got it! Got it. Let me check the pressure...good. It's in there.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Made the call yet?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Stay safe, alright? I gotta go.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: There's something in the fucking pods, man. Something MOVING. Something ALIVE.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: How did you get the pod open?!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Okay, alright, what do you need?!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Just hang on, I'll find a container!
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [It slithers. As it folds itself over the lip of the pod, it undulates in response to the light now barely cast over it. You think you hear Jorge say something, but you don't know for sure. Time slows, and you see the center of the pseudopod rise and a new one emerging, reaching out for you.]
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: One...
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Two...
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: ...Three! It's open, go! Go go go!!
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Okay...alright, it's slowing down... Okay, good. There. It's almost like it's...shrinking. Alright, let me close the pod.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You alright? Are we alright? It's...contained?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Wha- What are you doing, man?! Fuck's sake, alright! There! It's open! Keep spraying it!
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: What the fuck was that for, man? You almost froze my fucking hand off, Eli. What, they don't teach you how to count in that fancy school of yours?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I...it was an attempt at a joke.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: What was that? What the actual fuck, Eli?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I didn't see it. You tell me.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: ...I guess that's what we're looking for.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Sorry doesn't cut it. It's like you have no practical skills whatsoever. Fucking useless, man.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Sorry, Jorge. What do we do now?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I said I was sorry. Can we move on now?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You know...you could have counted a little faster.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: ...It's moving, Eli. It's fucking moving!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: ...Nice to see you so animated, Jorge.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Is that what this is to you? Some fucking joke before you go on to whatever appointment your family has lined up for you in Science City. Who cares if I get attacked by some sort of...fucking, I don't know, ink blob.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I apologize, Jorge. How can I make it up to you?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I said I'm sorry. What do we do now?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Well don't panic again. Not like that, not around...that thing. Ever again.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Alright, I'll be more careful next time we make an earth-shattering discovery.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'll do my best. That thing is weird.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [With no answer, Jorge grabs onto the top of the container, aggressively shoving the pod in front of him into it. It closes with an airlocked hiss.]
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Shit, man. I don't know. You can tell HQ about this. You owe me one after that stunt you pulled.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Wait, I need to tell HQ about this? You're the one who saw it!
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Don't. Just. Fucking. Don't.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Chill. We're fine for now. What do we do about our little friend?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Alright, alright. I'm sorry. What do we do now?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Ugh, fine. I...I guess it might be better to keep quiet 'til we've done some tests. If this is as big as I think it is, they could send in the cavalry to take credit before we can lay claim. But that would be against procedure, so...your call, not mine.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: That doesn't really help me much.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Here goes. You better be ready...twisting it...now! Go!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Try to see what's inside the pod]
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: It...I'm not sure. It was dark. Soon as I saw something glisten and lash out at me, I twisted the pod shut as well as I could. It was still reaching for me.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Not what I was anticipating. When you think of "historical artifacts" you don't really expect them to jump out at you.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'm not sure. Not really. I think I'm fine. I don't know. You good?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do you think? What was that?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I think so. We don't have any time to lose, though - I'll figure out our next steps. You go talk to HQ, alright?
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We need to lock that thing up. Put it in one of our containment pods.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I could say the same about you.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Shit, man. I don't know. I need a break. I need to catch my breath. You deal with HQ. I'm too frazzled to deal with their bullshit.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You stay here and rest. I'll take care of it.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Ugh. I hate talking to HQ. Fine.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: No. I mean, I did, but we're not talking about that. Not yet, anyway. I need to catch my breath.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Yeah. No. I don't know. We're not talking about it. Not just yet.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Are you sure it's completely contained?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I don't know what happened. I'm sorry, Jorge.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I don't know. But we've got it under control now. Contained. These things are airtight. Whatever that is, it's staying put.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I don't know! But next time I ask you to do something, I need you to listen! Especially when it involves...whatever the fuck that was!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I just couldn't help but stare at it.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I don't know what happened. I'm sorry, Jorge.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [Before you lift your hand, Jorge grabs hold of the container you've been holding on to, quickly shoving the pod inside it. It closes with an airlocked hiss.]
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: You too. We did alright. It's contained now.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We're keeping a tight lid on it. Did you talk to HQ yet? Any news?
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Could've done with a faster reaction from you, though. Why did you hesitate?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm sorry. I couldn't help but stare at it.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm not entirely sure. Sorry, Jorge.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I tried not to. Unsettling. Don't know what that thing is.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Same as always, I guess. We log it. You should probably give HQ a call. After that, I don't know.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Alright. You get some rest, okay?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Ah, man. I hate talking to HQ.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: It's alright. Just don't let it happen again.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Gesture to the container] So what now?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Yeah. These things are state of the art. Airtight, pressure-proof. You put something in here and it's never coming out unless you want it to.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: What do you mean, not yet? What the hell's the matter with you?!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Don't you want to know what that thing is?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Let me know what they say. I'm not going anywhere.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'm fine. I just need to process.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You do that. I'll get the radio going.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Gesture to the container] Think that's what we're supposed to find?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'm sure the tone will be more accommodating now that we have something interesting to report.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Guess we'll see. I'll be right back.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Think this is what they're hoping we'd find?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (CYNIC) Maybe we should hold off on telling them. They might send in someone to steal the credit.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (IDEALIST) They might even send someone over. Along with some new equipment.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (REALIST) It's been almost six months. I think they'll be happy to hear we're making progress.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Don't just stand there! We need to deal with this so it doesn't get out. Come on, man!
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What the...what are you talking about?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Tough luck. After that stunt you pulled, you owe me one.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Think that thing is what we're supposed to be looking for?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I don't know. If it was, I wonder if they would have sent just the two of us. Go on, give them a call. I need a breather.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Good job, Jorge. I mean it.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Go on, then. I'm going to take a breather.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Good job, Jorge. I mean it.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Hmm. Wouldn't be the first time that's happened. But what you're talking about is against procedure. So leave me out of it.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fair enough. I'll be right back, okay?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Will do. You get some rest, alright?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I wouldn't hold my breath, but you never know.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm feeling optimistic. Gonna go make the call.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Maybe I can swing it, somehow. I'll be right back.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'd like to wait and see until we know what kinda progress it'll be.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fingers crossed. I'll go make the call.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You and me both. I'll be right back, alright?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: HQ might see it differently. Go on, don't drag it out. I'll be here.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: The fruit of our labour is making my stomach turn, but fair enough. It's certainly 'progress'. Go on, make the call. I'll be here.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Progress is always a little unsettling. But you're right. Go on, tell HQ. I'm gonna stay here for a bit. Regain my composure.
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Not what I thought we'd find. I've been so preoccupied trying to get that pod to open, but I don't think I ever could have expected whatever that was.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Me neither. Just glad we're safe.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: When I saw it...wriggling, I panicked and doused it with cooling spray. It recoiled and retreated back into the pod, so that might do the trick. Then again, I don't want to open it up again unless we have to. We've got some containment pods packed up somewhere. Grab them as fast as you can, alright?
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: First things first: we need that thing pacified. I'll be right back.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: First things first: we need that thing contained. Don't go anywhere.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Firstly, you need to let HQ know. Just in case anything happens. After that, we document all of this. Every step. Then? I'm not sure. We should run some tests. See what we're dealing with.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Maybe we should hold off on telling HQ. Just until we know a little bit more, I mean.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I agree. The more we know what we're dealing with, the better.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Don't worry about me. I'll be fine. You go make the call.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm sure they'll be over the moon to hear about some actual results from us.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I suppose HQ would want to know as soon as possible.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I suppose so.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do you make of that thing?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Anything I can do for you?
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: My thoughts exactly.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What do you make of that thing?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Anything I can do to help you?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Alright then. I'll be right back.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Move it! I don't know what this thing is, and I'm don't want to find out while we're out here in the middle of fucking nowhere!
Data.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [What little you see leaves much to the imagination, in all the worst ways. Once the container twists open, a pseudopod, clad in shimmering black, perches itself on the edge, attempting to find enough traction to escape its habitat.]
Data.Name: Text
